book.name: MWANDUSO
book.title: KITABU CHA ICHANDUSO CHA MUSA KIKEMIGWA MWANDUSO

content: Dina Kobakigwa
Zua dimwe Dina, mwana wa Yakobo iyalelile na Lea, kachola kuwatembelela watwanzi Wakikanaani.
Ila Shekemu, yakalile mwana wa mkulu wa isi yakalile yokemigwa Hamoli Muhivi, viyamuwene Dina, kamkwida na kumuwasa kwa shuluti.
Moyo wa Shekemu unogelwa na Dina mndele wa Yakobo, na kamnogela ija imndele, na kalonga nayo mbuli zinogile.
Shekemu kamulongela Hamoli tataake, yolonga, “Nigwelele mndele ino yawe mtwanzi wangu.”
Yakobo viyahulike kamba Dina mndele wake katendeligwa mbuli zigela kinyala, wanage wakala kumgunda wochunga, avo kanyamala mbaka viwabwelile.
Na Hamoli tataake Shekemu kachola ha Yakobo giladi walongelele.

Wana wa Yakobo viwakalile wobwela kulawa kuchunga, wahulika gaja galawilile, wehilwa ng'hani na wona lusango, kwavija Shekemu kakala yatendile kinhu kihile ha Waislaeli kumuwasa kwa shuluti mndele wa Yakobo.
Ila Hamoli kawalongela Yakobo na wanage, “Mwanangu Shekemu kanogelwa ng'hani na mndele wenu, avo nowayalalila mmuleke yamsole mndele wenu.
Natuisole. Tugweleleni wandele zenu, na mweye wasoleni wandele zetu.
Avo mkale hano muisi yetu hamoja na tweye, mkale hanhu hohose hamulonda, tendeni uchuluzi mkuilegeha, na muwe na hanhu henu wenyego.”
Abaho Shekemu kamulongela tataake Dina na ndugu zake, “Munitogolele, na nowagweleleni chochose chumulonda.
Mnongele nhunza yaki yumulonda, na maliho gogose ga zengele gomulonda, nowagwelela kiasi chochose chumulonda, kamba muhanitogoza nie nimsole.”
Avo wanage Yakobo wamulongela Shekemu na Hamoli tataake mkuwavwizila, kwavija Shekemu kamtendela mbuli zigela kinyala lumbu jao Dina.
Wawalongela, “Hatudaha kutenda kinhu kino, kumgwelela lumbu jetu munhu hanakwingila kumbi, kumwetu tweye yowa kinyala.
Todaha kutogola kamba muhatenda kinhu kino, kamba kila mbigalo mmwanza wenu yehengizigwa kumbi kamba vituli tweye.
Abaho tweye towagwelela wandele zetu na tweye towasola wandele zenu, na tweye tokala hamoja na mweye na kugaluka wanhu wamwe.
Ila kamba hamtutogolela mweye kwingila kumbi, tomsola lumbu jetu, tochola nayo.”
Mbuli zija ziwanogela Hamoli na Shekemu mwanage.
Mmhale ija ayo yakalile yohishimilwa ng'hani kubanza wose mng'anda ya tataake, kalopola kugatenda gaja gawalongile kwavija kanogelwa na mndele wa Yakobo.
Avo Hamoli na mwanage Shekemu wachola ha ulwivi lwa idiwambo jao na kulonga na vilangizi wa idiwambo.
Walonga, “Wanhu wano wanoga, na tuwaleke wakale muisi yetu, na kutenda uchuluzi, isi ino ina hanhu bwando hakukala hewo. Tuwasole wandele zao na wasole wandele zetu.
Ila wanhu wano wotogola kukala hamoja na tweye, na kuwa hamoja na tweye, kamba tuhatogola wambigalo zetu wengizigwe kumbi kamba viwali hewo.
Kamba twahatenda vino, wang'onyo zao na vinhu vose viwalinavo vowa vetu. Na tuwatogolele mbuli zao, tuwaleke wakale hamoja na tweye.”
Wambigalo wose waiting'hane hana ulwivi lwa idiwambo waitogolela na Hamoli na Shekemu mwanage, na kila mbigalo muja mdiwambo kengizigwa kumbi.

Mazua madatu vigabitile, waja wengizigwe kumbi viwakalile wang'hali na usungu, wana wabili wa Yakobo, Simioni na Lawi lumbu zake Dina, wasola mizele yao, wadivamhila idiwambo mkwidukiza na kuwakoma wambigalo wose,
wawakoma Hamoli na Shekemu mwanage na zele, wamsola Dina lumbu jao kulawa mng'anda ya Shekemu, wachola nayo.
Viweshile kuwakoma, wana wayagwe wa Yakobo wengila mdiwambo na kusamha kila kinhu, kwavija lumbu jao kakala yatendeligwe mbuli zigela kinyala.
Wasola ng'hondolo, ng'ombe, mhunda, na kila kinhu kikalile mdiwambo dija na mmigunda.
Wasola mali gao gose, watwanzi zao wose, na wana zao, na wasola kila kinhu kikalile mng'anda zao.

Yakobo kawalongela Simioni na Lawi, “Mungalila mbuli, munitenda nie nihilwe na Wakanaani na Wapelizi na kila munhu yokala muisi ino. Nie nabule wanhu bwando, na kamba wahaiduganya hamoja na kunivamhila nie na wanhu wa ng'anda yangu, tobanangigwa.”
Wamwidika na lusango wolonga, “Habali tumuleke heyo yamtende lumbu jetu kamba mtenda ugoni ndwanga?”
